name: recipe-r-example
note: The build's example Recipe-R for the free-CPU variant. Copy it and replace every choice and evidence string with your own Module 6-10 decisions.

architecture.choice: Baseline-0 block (GQA, RoPE, QK-norm, SwiGLU, tied embeddings) at the ladder sizes
architecture.evidence: default, no Stage B change adopted in the example; replace with your Module 6 decision and its run card

optimizer.choice: Muon (match_rms update scaling) on hidden matrices, AdamW on embeddings and gains, peak lr 3e-3
optimizer.evidence: Module 7 decision; the build's CPU check (m11-r3, 300 steps): Muon 4.612 vs AdamW 5.216 validation loss, one seed, not a comparison

precision.choice: fp32 on CPU; bf16 autocast on the main path
precision.evidence: Module 8 decision; FP8 only if your 08.2 measurement passed its loss-gap rule

data.choice: Data-v0 retokenized at vocabulary 1,024 (CPU); Data-v1 at vocabulary 32,768 on the main path
data.evidence: Module 10 project decision. The CPU variant cannot combine the Module 7 and Module 10 wrappers in one run until the shared loop changes land (curriculum/inbox/module-11-shared-changes.md)

schedule.choice: linear warmup 5% of the run, cosine to 0.1x over each run's own length
schedule.evidence: 11.1: every ladder run gets its own schedule length (Hoffmann et al. appendix B)
